POWER MECHANICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Principles of Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Principles of Power Mechanics.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Principles of Power Mechanics.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Principles of Power Mechanics.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Principles of Power Mechanics.

2. When learning Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric projection.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker
